validity.researcher_notes: EXISTENCE: solidly real and under construction. P6718 is line '4' of the EWPS-1<->Shedgum leg of Aramco's Master Gas System expansion Phase 3 (MGS-3). Two independent origins confirm it: (1) MEED trade journalism ('Aramco selects contractors for Master Gas System expansion') describes Package 3 as 'laying 56-inch east-west gas pipelines three and four from EWPS-1 to Shedgum, covering 56 kilometres', contractor Gas Arabian; (2) Zawya reporting a company/EPC disclosure ('Saudi's GAS Arabian Services Company bags 2 EPC contracts from Aramco', 29 May 2024) names a 'Master Gas System expansion from SHEDGUM to EWPS-1' EPC worth SAR 344,614,412 (~$92M), 40-month duration, LOI Feb 2024, signed May 2024. Aramco's own $25bn contract-award release corroborates the overall program. HIGH confidence real. CLASSIFICATION: correct - 56-inch gas transmission trunk line (part of the MGS backbone), commodity Gas, PipelineType transmission. Not a gathering/process/feeder line. DUPLICATE CHECK: P6717 (EWPS-1-Shedgum '3', also 28km/56in) is the PARALLEL companion line on the same corridor, laid under the same single Package-3 EPC. This is a genuine second physical pipe (line 3 vs line 4), NOT a duplicate/double-count - do not merge. ATTRIBUTION: Owner/Operator Aramco 100% confirmed by both MEED (Aramco project) and Zawya (contracts awarded by Aramco). Endpoints EWPS-1 -> Shedgum, Saudi Arabia (Shedgum Gas Plant, Eastern Province). SPEC CAVEATS (documented divergences, not errors): (a) LENGTH - MEED states the EWPS-1<->Shedgum scope for BOTH lines 3 and 4 'covering 56 kilometres'; GEM records 28km for each line (P6717 + P6718 = 56km). Same halving is applied consistently across the network (EWPS-1-EWPS-3 300km->150+150, EWPS-3-EWPS-4 166km->83+83, etc.), so 28km per line = corridor length is a defensible reading, but it is GEM-derived, not source-stated per line. (b) COST - the sheet's cited Zawya source gives the Shedgum-EWPS-1 EPC as ~$92M for the combined scope (both lines 3 and 4); GEM records SegmentCost=$46M on this row, i.e. an even half-split ($46M x 2 = $92M). Reasonable allocation but the specific $46M is not stated by the source; the source figure is $92M for both lines together, and that EPC likely covers more than bare pipe (procurement/construction of both parallel lines). Flag as a transparent allocation, not a hard conflict.
